atlas_entries.name: aizawa
atlas_entries.description: Toroidal strange attractor with self-intersecting spirals forming a funnel/sphere topology. One of the most visually striking chaotic systems. Positive Lyapunov exponent confirms chaos.

atlas_entries.name: chua
atlas_entries.description: Double-scroll strange attractor. Simplest electronic circuit exhibiting chaos. Two scroll structures around each equilibrium point, connected by chaotic switching.

atlas_entries.name: thomas
atlas_entries.description: Thomas' cyclically symmetric attractor with sinusoidal coupling. At b=0.18: λ₁=0.1003, D_KY=2.107, D₀=1.700.

atlas_entries.name: halvorsen
atlas_entries.description: Cyclic polynomial strange attractor with 3-fold rotational symmetry. At a=1.4: λ₁=0.6440 (chaotic), D_KY=2.129, D₀=1.925. The system shows strong chaos at this parameter value.

atlas_entries.name: double_pendulum
atlas_entries.description: Classic chaotic Hamiltonian system with 2 DOF. EOM derived from Lagrangian. Positive Lyapunov exponent confirms deterministic chaos.

atlas_entries.name: standard_map
atlas_entries.description: As K increases past K_c~0.97, the last KAM torus breaks and global chaos sets in. Below K_c, invariant tori confine trajectories. Above, phase space becomes globally connected.
atlas_entries.equations: p_{n+1} = p_n + K*sin(theta_n), theta_{n+1} = theta_n + p_{n+1}

atlas_entries.name: henon_heiles
atlas_entries.description: Hénon-Heiles Poincaré sections at y=0 (upward crossing), vectorized RK4
